description: Amir Patel attends scheduled meeting with Kevin O'Brien at the bank to discuss capital improvement loan terms for two Level 2 EV charging stations. Presents prepared cost analysis ($8,000–$15,000 installation estimate), existing electrical infrastructure, and ChargePoint/Blink revenue-share offset model. Seeks written term sheet. No loan commitment made this tick — information-gathering and relationship advancement only.

secondary_transaction.description: Amir Patel submits a formal small business stabilization grant application to Maria Santos under the newly expanded 10% revenue decline threshold. Application documents: Auto Row fuel retail sector revenue index at 82 (18% below baseline), car ownership decline from 83% to 77% over five months, robotaxi displacement impact, and Phase 2 AV corridor impact data from comparable cities. Grant amount sought: up to $5,000.
